source: synthetic: pi-format transcripts that Craft's Pi backend writes to <workspace>/sessions/<sid>/.pi-sessions/ (craft-agents-oss packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:666-706, pi-mono session-manager.ts), a relocated workspace listed in config.json workspaces[].rootPath (TokenTracker src/lib/rollout.js:16047-16082; relative here because the fixture HOME moves), and TokenTracker's session.jsonl header from test/rollout-parser.test.js:10880-10917 (MIT © xiufengsun/TokenTracker), which is not read. step-2 rewrites the transcript whole with one new row (pi migration and Craft save rewrite files, craft.md §2).
differs: TokenTracker reads only the session.jsonl header snapshot (here 1000/5500/1100/200, cost 0.04). Its input and cache fields are the last call's prompt, not a sum, and Claude-backend sessions are also in ~/.claude/projects (craft.md §3, §6), so we read the Pi transcripts instead and leave Claude-backend usage to claude-code.
